extension.news:
[B]4.0.0[/B] - Port to modern stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache, fuzzywuzzy - Fix playback: respect liveProtocol (https) when resolving streams - Migrate endpoints and artwork to https - Disable developer's picks (dead feed, was breaking listings and search) - Fix search duplicate-title mismatches, harden JSON parsing - Fix Greek labels stripped by wrong response decoding (utf-8 enforced) - Versioned function cache so updates never serve stale listings - Skip stations with blank titles instead of showing "Unknown"
[B]3.0.X[/B] - Rework of main module and replace routing method with urldispatcher - Enhance search function with fuzzywuzzy - Caching tweaks - Various bug fixes
[B]2.1.0[/B] - Change cache method
[B]2.0.0[/B] - Version made to be compatible with Kodi Matrix (& Python 3.X) - Improved performance by enabling reuse language invoker - Various minor tweaks
[B]1.3.1[/B] - Refined radio list function to avoid creating duplicates
[B]1.3.0[/B] - Removed screenshots - Developer's picks are now inserted to "All stations" menu item as well - Stations will now be sorted according to title by default - Added search functionality - Cosmetics
